videos.title: Northern Tool Legends With Kyle Petty
videos.description: The students put the finishing touches on their custom motorcycle before taking it to the track. After months of hard work, the Legends Build comes to life—and the next chapter begins with a historic Build IV and a new team ready to make some history of their own.

videos.title: Fix It With Ms. A
videos.description: Ms. A diagnoses a car that won't start, showing how mechanics systematically narrow down problems until they find a solution.

videos.title: Lost Classics
videos.description: Tony digs out a rare Mustang that's been hidden under dusty boxes for decades, but the owner has another surprise in store. Then Tony gets a chance to size up a Model A truck at an auction preview before he heads to the famous Spring Carlisle.

videos.title: My Classic Car
videos.description: Host Dennis Gage upholds his "honor the timeless classics" catchphrase in this series, as he travels across North America to visit prestigious auto shows and events, spotlighting everything from muscle cars to museum pieces. The handlebar mustachioed Gage takes viewers along for the ride and keeps it entertaining with his unique perspective and enthusiasm for all things automotive.

videos.title: Stacey David's GearZ
videos.description: Stacey is not only showcasing 20 years of a how-to show, but also the tools that make it happen; he dives into the world of video games and pinball to show where they started, where they went and where they are now.

videos.title: Sam's Garage

videos.title: Fix It With Ms. A
videos.description: Ms. A tracks down what's secretly draining a car's battery while it's parked and shows how mechanics find an electrical draw.

videos.title: SEMA Battle of the Builders
videos.description: Ron Jones reimagines the 1973 Volkswagen Thing as a coach-built, Porsche-powered off-road machine; built around a one-off chromoly long-travel chassis, the vehicle combines hand-formed body panels, more than 350 machined components and performance engineering; follow the team's journey to unite art, comfort and all-terrain capability in an original creation worthy of an off-road category victory at the 2025 SEMA Battle of the Builders.
